put)
        if not isSeeking then return end
        if input ~= seekInput then return end
        isSeeking = false
        seekInput = nil
        SeekThumb.Visible = false
        SeekTooltip.Visible = false
        local pct = getSeekPercent(input.Position.X)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            pcall(function()
                local total = SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength
                if total > 0 then
                    local newPos = pct * total
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = newPos
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = newPos
                    if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                        SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    local function loadUserSongs()
        if type(readfile) ~= "function" then
            return {}
        end
        local ok, songs = pcall(function()
            local raw = readfile(USER_SONGS_FILE)
            if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then
                return {}
            end
            local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
            if type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.Songs) == "table" then
                return decoded.Songs
            end
            return {}
        end)
        if ok and type(songs) == "table" then
            return songs
        end
        warn("[YinYang Spotify] No se pudo leer el JSON de Mis canciones.")
        return {}
    end

    local function saveUserSongs()
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return false, GetText("Este ejecutor no permite guardar archivos.", "This executor does not support file saving.")
        end
        local serializable = {}
        for _, track in ipairs(SpotifyState.UserSongs) do
            serializable[#serializable + 1] = {
                Id = track.Id,
                Name = track.Name,
                Artist = track.Artist,
                Duration = track.Duration,
                Cover = track.Cover,
                CoverURL = track.CoverURL,
                AudioURL = track.AudioURL,
                CacheName = track.CacheName,
                CoverCacheName = track.CoverCacheName,
            }
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            writefile(USER_SONGS_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({Version = 1, Songs = serializable}))
        end)
        return ok, (not ok) and GetText("No se pudo escribir el archivo JSON.", "Could not write the JSON file.") or nil
    end

    local function normalizeDownloadUrl(value)
        local url = trim(value)
        if url == "" then return "" end
        if url:match("^http://github%.com/") or url:match("^http://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/") then
            url = url:gsub("^http://", "https://")
        end
        -- GitHub's normal file-view URL is not the file itself; convert it to raw content.
        local owner, repo, branch, path = url:match("^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$")
        if owner and repo and branch and path then
            path = path:gsub("%?.*$", ""):gsub("#.*$", "")
            url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. owner .. "/" .. repo .. "/" .. branch .. "/" .. path
        else
            local rawOwner, rawRepo, rawBranch, rawPath = url:match("^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/raw/([^/]+)/(.+)$")
            if rawOwner and rawRepo and rawBranch and rawPath then
                url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. rawOwner .. "/" .. rawRepo .. "/" .. rawBranch .. "/" .. rawPath
            end
        end
        return url
    end

    local function isDirectMp3Url(value)
        local url = normalizeDownloadUrl(value)
        if not url:match("^https://") then
            return false
        end
        local path = (url:match("^https://[^/]+([^?#]*)") or ""):lower()
        return path:match("%.mp3$") ~= nil
    end

    UserSongURL.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local originalUrl = trim(UserSongURL.Text)
        local normalizedUrl = normalizeDownloadUrl(originalUrl)
        if normalizedUrl ~= originalUrl then
            UserSongURL.Text = normalizedUrl
            UserSongStatus.Text = GetText("Enlace de GitHub convertido a descarga directa.", "GitHub link converted to a direct download.")
            UserSongStatus.TextColor3 = spotifyGreen
        end
    end)

    UserSongCover.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local originalUrl = trim(UserSongCover.Text)
        local normalizedUrl = normalizeDownloadUrl(originalUrl)
        if normalizedUrl ~= originalUrl then UserSongCover.Text = normalizedUrl end
    end)

    local function addUserSong()
        local name = trim(UserSongName.Text)
        local artist = trim(UserSongArtist.Text)
        local audioUrl = normalizeDownloadUrl(UserSongURL.Text)
        local coverUrl = normalizeDownloadUrl(UserSongCover.Text)

        if name == "" or artist == "" or audioUrl == "" then
            UserSongStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125)
            UserSongStatus.Text = GetText("Completá nombre, artista y enlace MP3.", "Enter the song title, artist, and MP3 link.")
            return
        end
        if #name > 100 or #artist > 100 then
            UserSongStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125)
            UserSongStatus.Text = GetText("El nombre y el artista deben tener 100 caracteres o menos.", "Song title and artist must be 100 characters or fewer.")
            return
        end
        if not isDirectMp3Url(audioUrl) then
            UserSongStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125)
            UserSongStatus.Text = GetText("El enlace debe ser HTTPS y terminar en .mp3. Los enlaces de GitHub se convierten automáticamente.", "The link must be HTTPS and end in .mp3. GitHub links are converted automatically.")
            return
        end
        if coverUrl ~= "" and not coverUrl:match("^https://") then
            UserSongStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125)
            UserSongStatus.Text = GetText("La portada debe usar un enlace HTTPS directo.", "The cover must use a direct HTTPS link.")
            return
        end

        local slug = (name .. "_" .. artist):lower():gsub("[^%w]+", "_"):gsub("^_+", ""):gsub("_+$", "")
        if slug == "" then slug = "user_song" end
        local id = "user_" .. tostring(os.time()) .. "_" .. tostring(math.random(1000, 9999))
        local track = {
            Id = id,
            Name = name,
            Artist = artist,
            Duration = "0:00",
            Cover = "",
            CoverURL = coverUrl,
            CoverCacheName = coverUrl ~= "" and (slug .. "_" .. id .. "_cover.jpg") or "",
            AudioURL = audioUrl,
            CacheName = "YinYang_UserSong_" .. slug .. "_" .. id .. ".mp3",
            IsUserSong = true,
        }

        table.insert(SpotifyState.UserSongs, track)
        local ok, err = saveUserSongs()
        if not ok then
            table.remove(SpotifyState.UserSongs, #SpotifyState.UserSongs)
            UserSongStatus.Text = tostring(err or GetText("No se pudo guardar la canción.", "Could not save the song."))
            return
        end

        local normalized = normalizeTrack(track, #SpotifyState.Catalog + 1)
        if normalized then
            normalized.IsUserSong = true
            table.insert(SpotifyState.Catalog, normalized)
        end
        SpotifyState.MySongsView = true
        SpotifyState.FavoritesView = false
        SpotifyState.CatalogLoaded = true
        closeUserSongForm()
        SongSearchBox.Text = ""
        SongList.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
        UserSongStatus.Text = ""
    end
    UserSongSave.Activated:Connect(addUserSong)

    local renderSongRows
    local clearSongRows
    local createSongRow
    local resolveTrackCoverImage
    local createFavoritesTile
    local createMySongsTile
    local FavPage = {}

    local function refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
        local favorites = SpotifyState.FavoritesView == true
        local mySongs = SpotifyState.MySongsView == true
        local subview = favorites or mySongs
        FavoritesHeader.Visible = subview
        FavoritesHeaderTitle.Text = mySongs and GetText("Mis canciones", "My songs") or GetText("Favoritos", "Favorites")
        FavoritesHeaderTitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", mySongs and "Mis canciones" or "Favoritos")
        FavoritesHeaderTitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", mySongs and "My songs" or "Favorites")
        AddUserSongButton.Visible = mySongs
        SongSearchHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, subview and 50 or 8)
        SongList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, subview and 86 or 50)
        SongList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, subview and -92 or -56)
        if SpotifyState.CatalogLoaded then
            renderSongRows()
        end
    end

    FavoritesBackButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        SpotifyState.FavoritesView = false
        SpotifyState.MySongsView = false
        SongList.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
    end)

    SongSearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        SpotifyState.SearchQuery = SongSearchBox.Text or ""
        if renderSongRows then
            renderSongRows()
        end
        updateSongListCanvas()
    end)

    SpotifyRootLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        updateSpotifyCanvas()
    end)

    local function applySpotifyNowPlayingLayout()
        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local albumSz = m.compact and 118 or 132
        local cardW = 0
        pcall(function() cardW = NowPlayingCard.AbsoluteSize.X end)
        local compactCard = cardW > 0 and cardW < 640
        if compactCard then
            albumSz = math.min(albumSz, 118)
        end

        NowPlayingCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

        AlbumArt.Size = UDim2.new(0, albumSz, 0, albumSz)
        AlbumArt.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(albumSz / 2), 0, 12)

        InfoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 62)
        InfoFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, albumSz + 22)

        PlayerSongTitle.TextSize = compactCard and 19 or 21
        PlayerSongArtist.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 27)
        PlayerSongArtist.TextSize = compactCard and 12 or 13
        PlayerMeta.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 46)
        PlayerMeta.TextSize = 10

        local progressTop = albumSz + 96
        ProgressTrack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 5)
        SeekHitbox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28)
        ProgressTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, progressTop)
        SeekHitbox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, progressTop - 14)
        ProgressTimeLeft.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, progressTop + 11)
        ProgressTimeRight.Position = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, progressTop + 11)
        ProgressTimeLeft.TextSize = 11
        ProgressTimeRight.TextSize = 11

        Controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 44)
        Controls.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, progressTop + 34)

        RepeatBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
        RepeatBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.5, 0)
        LikeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
        LikeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.22, 0, 0.5, 0)

        PlayPauseBtnOuter.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
        PlayPauseBtnOuter.Position = UDim2.new(0.50, 0, 0.5, 0)
        PlayPauseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
        PlayPauseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0.5, -9)

        NextBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
        NextBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.78, 0, 0.5, 0)
        MoreBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
        MoreBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.5, 0)

        if SavedConfig.TabIconLayout == "Carousel" then
            local cardH = 0
            pcall(function() cardH = NowPlayingCard.AbsoluteSize.Y / tabCarouselScale() end)
            if cardH < 120 then cardH = 270 end

            local sideAlbum = math.floor(math.clamp(cardH - 28, 96, 170))
            local leftX = 14 + sideAlbum + 18
            local rightW = leftX + 14
            local top = math.max(8, math.floor((cardH - 148) / 2))
            local progressTopC = top + 70

            AlbumArt.Size = UDim2.new(0, sideAlbum, 0, sideAlbum)
            AlbumArt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, math.max(8, math.floor((cardH - sideAlbum) / 2)))

            InfoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -rightW, 0, 62)
            InfoFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftX, 0, top)

            ProgressTrack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -rightW, 0, 5)
            ProgressTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftX, 0, progressTopC)
            SeekHitbox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -rightW, 0, 28)
            SeekHitbox.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftX, 0, progressTopC - 14)
            ProgressTimeLeft.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftX, 0, progressTopC + 11)
            ProgressTimeRight.Position = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, progressTopC + 11)

            Controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, -rightW, 0, 44)
            Controls.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftX, 0, progressTopC + 34)
        end
    end

    local function applySpotifyRowLayout(rowData)
        if not rowData or not rowData.Row then
            return
        end

        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local cardH = m.compact and 228 or 242
        local coverPad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local availableW = math.max(0, SongList.AbsoluteSize.X - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / m.gridColumns))
        local coverSize = math.max(76, cellW - 20)
        coverSize = math.floor(math.min(coverSize, m.compact and 138 or 182))

        rowData.Row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize + 20), cardH)
        rowData.Row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24)
        rowData.Row.BackgroundTransparency = 0

        if rowData.Accent then
            rowData.Accent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
            rowData.Accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        end

        if rowData.Cover then
            rowData.Cover.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(coverSize, coverSize)
            rowData.Cover.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(coverSize / 2), 0, coverPad)
        end

        local titleTop = coverPad + coverSize + (m.compact and 8 or 10)
        local sidePad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local textW = math.max(40, coverSize + 20 - sidePad * 2)

        if rowData.Title then
            rowData.Title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(textW, m.compact and 34 or 38)
            rowData.Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, sidePad, 0, titleTop)
            rowData.Title.TextSize = m.compact and 11 or 13
        end

        if rowData.Artist then
            rowData.Artist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(textW, 16)
            rowData.Artist.Position = UDim2.new(0, sidePad, 0, titleTop + (m.compact and 36 or 40))
            rowData.Artist.TextSize = m.compact and 9 or 10
        end

        if rowData.Duration then
            rowData.Duration.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16)
            rowData.Duration.Position = UDim2.new(0, sidePad, 0, titleTop + (m.compact and 36 or 40) + 16)
            rowData.Duration.TextSize = 9
            rowData.Duration.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        end

        if rowData.Plus then
            rowData.Plus.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
            rowData.Plus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
            rowData.Plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -7, 1, -5)
        end

        if rowData.Play then
            rowData.Play.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
            rowData.Play.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
            rowData.Play.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, coverPad + coverSize - 4)
        end

        if rowData.TapArea then
            rowData.TapArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            rowData.TapArea.ZIndex = 14
        end
    end

    local function refreshSpotifyUILayout()
        applySpotifyNowPlayingLayout()
        local width = SongList.AbsoluteSize.X
        local columns = 3
        local gapX = width < 420 and 8 or 12
        local gapY = width < 420 and 12 or 16
        local side = 4
        local availableW = math.max(0, width - (side * 2) - (gapX * (columns - 1)))
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / columns))
        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local rowAvailW = math.max(0, width - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local rowCoverSize = math.floor(math.min(math.max(76, math.floor(rowAvailW / m.gridColumns) - 20), m.compact and 138 or 182))
        local cellH = (m.compact and 9 or 11) + rowCoverSize + (m.compact and 8 or 10) + (m.compact and 36 or 40) + 32 + (m.compact and 9 or 11)
        if SongListLayout then
            SongListLayout.FillDirectionMaxCells = columns
            SongListLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(gapX, gapY)
            SongListLayout.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(cellW, cellH)
        end
        if SpotifyState.CatalogLoaded then
            -- anti-lag: las tarjetas solo se re-arman si cambió el layout (mover la ventana no cambia nada)
            local layoutKey = table.concat({ columns, gapX, gapY, cellW, cellH, rowCoverSize, tostring(m.compact) }, "|")
            if SpotifyState._LayoutKey ~= layoutKey then
                SpotifyState._LayoutKey = layoutKey
                renderSongRows()
            end
        end
        updateSpotifyCanvas()
    end

    local layoutRefreshQueued = false
    local function queueSpotifyLayoutRefresh()
        -- anti-lag: durante la animación de abrir/cerrar (MainScale distinto de 1) el tamaño real no cambia
        if MainScale.Scale ~= 1 then
            return
        end
        if layoutRefreshQueued then
            return
        end
        layoutRefreshQueued = true
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait()
            layoutRefreshQueued = false
            pcall(refreshSpotifyUILayout)
        end)
    end

    SPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(queueSpotifyLayoutRefresh)
    SongList:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(queueSpotifyLayoutRefresh)
    ContentArea:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(queueSpotifyLayoutRefresh)
    ContentArea:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(queueSpotifyLayoutRefresh)

    local function isLiked(index)
        return SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] == true
    end

    local function loadSpotifyFavorites()
        SpotifyState.CurrentLiked = {}
        local savedFavorites = type(SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites) == "table" and SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites or {}
        for index, track in ipairs(SpotifyState.Catalog) do
            if savedFavorites[tostring(track.Id)] == true then
                SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] = true
            end
        end
    end

    local function saveSpotifyFavorite(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end
        SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites = type(SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites) == "table" and SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites or {}
        local id = tostring(track.Id)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] == true then
            SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites[id] = true
        else
            SavedConfig.SpotifyFavorites[id] = nil
        end
        SaveConfig()
    end

    local function updateTrackRow(rowData, index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not rowData or not rowData.Row or not track then
            return
        end

        applySpotifyRowLayout(rowData)

        local active = (index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        rowData.Row.BackgroundColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 44) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)

        if rowData.Accent then
            rowData.Accent.Visible = active
        end

        if rowData.Cover then
            rowData.Cover.Image = resolveTrackCoverImage(track)
        end

        if rowData.Title then
            rowData.Title.Text = track.Name
            rowData.Title.TextColor3 = active and spotifyGreen or spotifyText
        end

        if rowData.Artist then
            rowData.Artist.Text = track.Artist
            rowData.Artist.TextColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 120) or spotifyDim
        end

        if rowData.Duration then
            rowData.Duration.Text = track.Duration
        end

        if rowData.Plus then
            pcall(function()
                rowData.Plus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                rowData.Plus.Image = asset(116559368303288)
                rowData.Plus.ImageColor3 = spotifyText
            end)
        end

        if rowData.Play then
            pcall(function()
                rowData.Play.Image = asset(135609604299893)
                rowData.Play.ImageTransparency = 0
                rowData.Play.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                rowData.Play.ImageColor3 = spotifyText
            end)
        end
    end

    local function refreshAllRows()
        for i, rowData in pairs(SpotifyState.RowButtons) do
            updateTrackRow(rowData, i)
        end
    end

    renderSongRows = function()
        clearSongRows()
        local order = getVisibleRenderOrder()
        local displayOrder = 1
        local query = normalizeSearchText(SpotifyState.SearchQuery or "")

        if not SpotifyState.FavoritesView and not SpotifyState.MySongsView and query == "" then
            local favoritesOk, favoritesErr = pcall(function()
                createFavoritesTile(displayOrder)
            end)
            if not favoritesOk then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] No se pudo crear la tarjeta de Favoritos: " .. tostring(favoritesErr))
            end
            displayOrder = displayOrder + 1

            local mySongsOk, mySongsErr = pcall(function()
                createMySongsTile(displayOrder)
            end)
            if not mySongsOk then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] No se pudo crear la tarjeta Mis canciones: " .. tostring(mySongsErr))
            end
            displayOrder = displayOrder + 1
        end

        for _, index in ipairs(order) do
            local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            if track then
                pcall(function()
                    createSongRow(track, index, displayOrder)
                end)
                displayOrder = displayOrder + 1
            end
        end
        updateSongListCanvas()
        updateSpotifyCanvas()
        task.defer(function()
            pcall(updateSongListCanvas)
            pcall(updateSpotifyCanvas)
        end)
    end

    local function updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, statusText)
        if not track then
            return
        end

        local seed = tostring(track.Id or track.Name or index or "spotify")
        local hash = 0
        for i = 1, #seed do
            hash = (hash * 31 + string.byte(seed, i)) % 360
        end
        local fallbackColor = Color3.fromHSV(hash / 360, 0.52, 0.28)
        local resolvedCover = resolveTrackCoverImage(track)
        local hasCover = trim(resolvedCover or "") ~= ""

        NowPlayingBackdrop.Image = hasCover and resolvedCover or ""
        NowPlayingBackdrop.ImageTransparency = hasCover and 0.55 or 1
        NowPlayingBackdrop.BackgroundColor3 = hasCover and Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10) or fallbackColor
        NowPlayingBackdrop.BackgroundTransparency = hasCover and 0.12 or 0.06
        NowPlayingShade.BackgroundTransparency = hasCover and 0.52 or 0.30
        AlbumArt.Image = hasCover and resolvedCover or ""
        AlbumArt.BackgroundColor3 = hasCover and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or fallbackColor
        AlbumFallback.Visible = not hasCover

        PlayerSongTitle.Text = track.Name
        PlayerSongArtist.Text = track.Artist
        PlayerMeta.Text = statusText or (SpotifyState.IsPlaying and "Reproducción activa" or "Reproducción lista")
        ProgressTimeRight.Text = track.Duration

        if index and SpotifyState.Catalog[index] then
            SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        end

        refreshAllRows()
        refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

    local function destroyCurrentSound()
        if SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection:Disconnect()
            end)
            SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection = nil
        end

        if SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection:Disconnect()
            end)
            SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection = nil
        end

        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            pcall(function()
                SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Stop()
            end)
            safeDestroy(SpotifyState.CurrentSound)
            SpotifyState.CurrentSound = nil
        end
    end

    local function syncPlaybackUI()
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            PlayPauseBtn.Image = SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
        else
            PlayPauseBtn.Image = asset(135609604299893)
        end

        RepeatBtn.ImageColor3 = SpotifyState.IsRepeat and spotifyGreen or spotifyText
        LikeBtn.ImageColor3 = isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) and spotifyGreen or spotifyText

        if isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) then
            LikeBtn.Image = asset(116559368303288)
        else
            LikeBtn.Image = asset(116559368303288)
        end
        refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
        if SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged then
            pcall(SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged)
        end
    end

    local function updateProgress(track, sound)
        local total = track and durationToSeconds(track.Duration) or 0
        if sound and sound.TimeLength and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
            total = math.max(total, math.floor(sound.TimeLength))
        end
        total = math.max(total, 1)

        local current = 0
        if sound and sound.TimePosition then
            current = math.floor(sound.TimePosition)
        end

        ProgressTimeLeft.Text = secondsToClock(current)
        ProgressTimeRight.Text = (track and track.IsUserSong and sound and sound.TimeLength > 0)
            and secondsToClock(sound.TimeLength)
            or (track and track.Duration or secondsToClock(total))
        ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp(current / total, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
        refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

    local function ensureTrackCached(track)
        local cacheName = track.CacheName
        local audioExists = false
        local audioPath = cacheName

        if isfile then
            local okFile, resultFile = pcall(function()
                return isfile(audioPath)
            end)
            audioExists = okFile and resultFile == true
        end

        if not audioExists then
            if not writefile then
                return false, "writefile_unavailable"
            end

            local okDownload, data = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(track.AudioURL, true)
            end)

            if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 10 then
                return false, "download_failed"
            end

            local okWrite = pcall(function()
                writefile(audioPath, data)
            end)

            if not okWrite then
                return false, "cache_write_failed"
            end
        end

        local customAsset = audioPath
        if getcustomasset then
            local okAsset, resultAsset = pcall(function()
                return getcustomasset(audioPath)
            end)
            if okAsset and type(resultAsset) == "string" then
                customAsset = resultAsset
            end
        end

        return true, customAsset
    end

    local function ensureCoverCached(track)
        if not track.CoverURL or track.CoverURL == "" then
            return false, "no_cover_url"
        end

        local cacheName = track.CoverCacheName
        if no
